we have developed an efficient and scalable method for distributed calculation of response times for large GSPNs using MapReduce and Hadoop.

the proposed method can be used for the calculation of the response time densities and quantile of the semi-Markov processes underlying large GSPNs, and that it scales well with the number of nodes in the Hadoop cluster.

the implementation of a distributed response time analysis module using Hadoop and the Platform Independent Petni Net Editor (PIPE2), an open source tool for modelling and analysis of GSPN, has been developed and tested.

the development of a distributed response time analysis method for GSPN models using MapReduce.
the development of a new distributed algorithm for response time analysis of GSPN models using the MapReduce framework.
the development and validation of a distributed response time analysis method for large scale GSPNs, which is based on the MapReduce framework.

the proposed approach provides an excellent alternative to the state of the art in distributed response time analysis of GSPNs.

the proposed method can be used for distributed response time analysis of large GSPNs with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency.
